title: Decide whether test-run cards appear in the pane's Commands view mode
outcome: From /review-changes round 3 (Claude, delegation 46004bcb; gate test-171aa649) on the corrected UI/Test Runs changeset. Note. Test-run cards render in the command-card family, but ui/src/SessionPaneView.messages.ts:20 (commandMessagesForPaneViewMode) keeps only type === 'command', so testRun cards are missing from the Commands view mode. Decide: include 'testRun' there, or record in docs/features/test-runs.md 'Card rendering' that the Commands view deliberately leaves them out.
